d:
What happens when you and your best friend fall for the same guy?
Ruhi, Tanya and Rahul are inseparable college friends until feelings start making their friendship a little too complicated. Tanya has a crush on Rahul, Ruhi is determined to help her best friend win him over, and Rahul? Well, his signals aren't exactly making things easier.
Watch this college love triangle unfold as friendship, crushes and mixed signals collide. Will a guy come between two best friends, or is there more to the story?
Watch Part 1 and stay tuned for Part 2!
